name: Pietro Petriello
bioAdditions: Three FamilySearch-indexed Avellino civil records are attached to Pietro's tree profile (S1). The first (ark 1:1:6PG6-674L) indexes Pietro together with Grazia di Marino (6PG6-674V) and her parents Gaetano di Marino (6PG6-674K) and Caterina di Leo (6PG6-6742), all under one record. That pattern is typical of a marriage act, so it is very likely the Petriello–Di Marino marriage that Round 3 could not find in the Antenati indexes. The second (6PJX-KPGJ, with Angelo Petriello, Lucia Marra and Grazia) is his 1901 death act, already read. The third is the 16 Dec 1885 birth of daughter Filomena at Carife (QPR6-CHPY), which places Pietro and Grazia in neighbouring Carife in 1885. The images are blocked from here, so the record date of 6PG6-674L is unknown.
openQuestionsNew: Open FamilySearch record 1:1:6PG6-674L (Avellino Stato Civile) while logged in: it is probably Pietro and Grazia's marriage act (c.1862-68) and will give its date, comune and act number.
Why was daughter Filomena born at Carife in 1885? Temporary residence, or Grazia's home parish?
